title: AI looked at this clock and said 9:30
markup: One scene per spoken line, so a changed line is re-voiced alone. Numbers stay as words here; screen and captions show figures. Approved G0, Nov 19 2026.

scenes.title: Line 1
scenes.vo: In a twenty twenty-four test, an AI looked at this clock and said: nine-thirty.

scenes.title: Line 3
scenes.vo: Others said nine o'clock, or ten to five. Out of five AIs, only one got it right.

scenes.title: Line 4
scenes.vo: Why? It swapped the hands. It read the long hand, on the nine, as the hour, and the short hand, near the six, as the minutes.

scenes.title: Line 5
scenes.vo: It's like someone describing a clock to you over the phone: "One hand near the nine, one near the six." Which is which? Guess wrong, and quarter to six becomes nine-thirty.

scenes.title: Line 6
scenes.vo: So when an AI sounds sure, remember this clock.
